home.heroDesc: FarmOS connects farmers directly to transparent markets and verified buyers — eliminating intermediaries and maximizing harvest value.
home.feature1Desc: Bypass traditional middleman markups. List your crop directly to verified regional traders, millers, and commercial buyers.
home.feature2Desc: Calculate real gross returns, road transport freight logistics, and net returns across regional APMC mandis to maximize profit.
home.feature3Desc: Access official daily Agmarknet benchmark prices (min, max, modal) for hundreds of commodities across Indian states.
